name: Kikaijikake no Yakata
source:
Main character finds a job at a huge mansion. The lady of the house only asks him not to enter the middle door on the second floor where her ill husband resides. She also asks to never bring out and forget everything protagonist sees in this house. Soon he discovers training room in the basement.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一座巨大宅邸里找到了一份工作。女主人只要求他不要进入二楼中间那扇门，因为病重的丈夫就住在门后。她还要求主角不要把在宅邸中看到的一切带出去，也不要记住。很快，他在地下室发现了一间训练室。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
